notes:
Player: drive the countdown from the wall clock

setInterval ticks were counted one by one, so a WebView that throttles or
suspends timers in the background made a step run long. Each tick now reads the
remaining time from a deadline, which self-corrects on resume, and the interval
no longer restarts on every step. Arming the step in an effect also fixes the
countdown starting at zero when the routine loads after the first render.

Also upload the debug APK as a run artifact so it can be downloaded from the
Actions tab, not only from the Release.
